title: Refactor slowquery.php to TypeScript
problem_statement: The slowquery.php script uses direct file access and lacks modern error handling.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues.
suggested_approach: Convert the PHP script to TypeScript, using asynchronous file operations and proper error handling.
success_criteria: File operations are secure and validated.

provenance.evidence: Legacy PHP script for slow query logging.
